title: Radial dither bloom

reference.source: Reference 19: dithered radial bloom in indigo, lilac and pale yellow, 735 × 920 px JPEG.
reference.note: held locally; this page carries statistics measured from it and none of its pixels

summary: A light field of a beveled panel, bead-chain capsules and a corner light, sampled once per 2.21 px cell and printed as a diagonal checker of two inks, breaks placed by a hash.
units: reference pixels; the plate is 735 × 920 and every length scales with the canvas

cell.does: Size of one dither cell. The reference's checkerboard peaks at 0.227 cycles per px, a 2.21 px cell.

depth.does: How far apart the two checker phases print: 0 posterizes each cell to its nearest ink, 1 splits mid-tones into a full two-ink checker.

grain.does: Share of cells that swap checker phase. 0 keeps the diagonal checker exact; 1 is a random dither.

enlarge.does: How the cell grid is enlarged to the page. 0 keeps hard square cells; 1 interpolates linearly between cell centers, as the reference file does.

dust.does: One-pixel light specks on the bare black, 0.65 % of pixels per unit; the reference's black corner carries about 1.3 %.

light.does: Where the light sits around the center. 225 is the upper left corner, 270 straight up.

falloff.does: How fast the panel falls from pale to black across the sheet.

warm.does: How much of the lit corner turns pale yellow instead of white and lilac.

rays.does: Capsules around the center; the reference carries about 17.

beads.does: Beads chained along each capsule, growing outward; the last carries the cap.

dark.does: How far each bead's core pushes past its rim: darker on the pale ground, whiter on the dark. 0 makes smooth capsules.

size.does: Width of capsules and beads; a capsule's outer end is 62 px across at 1.

reach.does: Capsule length as a share of the distance to the panel edge. Above 1 the caps spill onto the bevel.

blur.does: Half width of a capsule's soft edge. The yellow cap's inner arc stays hard.

cap.does: Radius of the hard yellow cap at each capsule tip, as a share of the tip radius.

spill.does: Opacity of a capsule where it leaves the panel. Below 1 the panel edge draws a hard line across every cap.

twist.does: Spiral turn of the rays with radius.

spin.does: Rotation of the ray set and the teeth.

scatter.does: Random spread in each ray's angle, length, waist and bead size.

ring.does: Outer radius of the tooth ring; the hole is 0.36 of it.

petals.does: Yellow teeth in the zigzag ring; fewer teeth cut deeper, to a depth of 3.4 / teeth of the ring radius (0.28 at 12, at most 0.45).

frame.does: Distance from the sheet edge to the panel edge, 55 to 68 px on the reference.

bevel.does: Length of the halo ramp from the panel edge out to black.

halo.does: Brightness of the halo at the panel edge.

seed.does: Re-rolls ray angles, lengths, waists, beads, threshold noise and dust.

modes.saw: value up to value + amp over period seconds, then again
modes.drift: seeded walk, one step of up to amp every period seconds, folded back at the slider ends

motion.runs: only while Motion is on, at half scale; the sliders hold the center values; off by default

live.runs: only while Live is on: a drag on the figure sets x across and y down between these ends; off by default

techniques.name: Edge
techniques.implementation: Center: 12 yellow teeth in a zigzag around a black hole 0.36 of the ring radius, on a lilac disc with a dark collar.

techniques.name: Tone
techniques.implementation: Bead chain on the pale ground: the dark phase prints indigo and the light phase lilac, inside a yellow and olive checker.

techniques.name: Grain
techniques.implementation: At 4x: the pale ground is a diagonal checker of yellow and olive, the olive phase broken to yellow at hashed cells, 2.21 px per cell.

pass_order: light field per dither cell: a radial light from the upper left corner (tone falls with distance, warm only where it is bright), a square panel inset 55 to 68 px, a halo that ramps from the panel edge to black over 50 px with mitered corners

capsules: 17 rays, each a chain of four overlapping beads growing outward; on the pale ground a bead pushes darker, on the dark ground lighter, so the same chain reads as indigo beads up top and white-cored lobes below
caps: the outer bead ends in a pale yellow disc with a hard inner arc that spills past the panel at 0.9 opacity
center: a dark collar, a lilac disc, a zigzag of 12 yellow teeth, a black hole at 0.36 of the ring radius

dither, checker first: each cell belongs to one phase of the diagonal checker; the light phase quantizes T + h and the dark phase T − h (h = depth × min(T − floor, 1 − T)) along the cell's ink ladder (warm: black, olive, yellow; gray: black, indigo, white; saturated: black, indigo, lilac, white, chosen by hashed draws against warmth and saturation); cells that break to the next rung are placed by a per-cell hash, so no row or tile pattern appears
print: the 2.21 px cell grid is enlarged to the page with 0.8 linear interpolation between cell centers; one-pixel lilac dust lands on the bare black

dither_cell_px.method: grid search over cell size and phase for the largest neighbor contrast at cell centers; 2-D FFT peaks at 0.227 cycles per px on both diagonals (3.12 px) in four patches

inks_per_cell_kmeans7.note: two more clusters at [66, 62, 108] and [115, 112, 150] are interpolated mixes between cells, not inks

yellow_p90.method: 90th percentile of warm pixels (B below R by 15) in the top left bevel

panel_inset_px.method: end of the halo ramp on 9 px box-filtered luminance profiles across each edge

halo_ramp_px.method: panel edge to black on the same profiles

dust_on_black.method: components above L 40 in a 100 × 80 px black patch

checker_phase.method: cells of the pale ground thresholded 25 levels under their median: dark cells sit on one diagonal phase only (P of a dark axis neighbor 0.00 to 0.01, of a dark diagonal neighbor 0.77 to 0.84), 39 to 41 % of all cells
checker_phase.olive_method: median of local minima in two pale-ground patches; p10 [162, 163, 117]

cell_softness.method: AC at lag 1 to 4 against nearest, bilinear and cubic enlargements of an ideal ordered dither of the blurred reference
cell_softness.result: lag-1 AC 0.31 in the panel patch sits between nearest (0.43) and bilinear (0.79) after a 2.21x enlargement; the render's enlarge 0.8 is the bench optimum

benchmark.computed: live, when this page loads, by the code that measured the reference: default parameters, Indigo bloom palette, 1× reference size

setup.note: The rays are generated, so the bead chain, bright lobe, panel field and dark ground rects were re-picked after the rebuild and again after the checker-first dither (panel field picked on autocorrelation in the mid-tone zone), with search.py's window scan, each restricted to the matching zone of the render (bead chain in the lit upper half, lobe and dark ground in the lower right). The bevel corner and the whole plate compare in place.

limits: Bench mean 0.919, under 98 %. The lowest metric is the bead chain tone histogram (0.76): the reference file's cells were enlarged and JPEG-softened, so its histograms carry a continuous spread between inks that the render's 0.8 linear enlarge only partly makes. The panel field contrast scores 0.79 for the same reason (σ 53 against 67); enlarge 0.65 lifts it to 0.89, the panel autocorrelation from 0.865 to 0.929 and the mean to 0.924, but the brief keeps the measured 0.8.
The bevel corner's indigo class scores 0.82: the reference's top bevel dark cells are olive-black, and the render's bevel still mixes in indigo where the halo cools toward the sides.
The rays are generated, not traced. Searched windows compare a lobe of the render with a lobe of the reference, not the same lobe, so tone shares differ with where each lobe sits under the light.
Cell edges at 3 to 5x are soft by design (enlarge 0.8) because the reference's are; enlarge 0 gives hard square cells.
Lobe cores on the pale ground can print short indigo runs on both phases where bead depth pushes the tone under the light rung; the reference's cores keep the light phase lighter.
The dark ground's mean scores 0.85 (6.5 against 5.5 levels): 3 % indigo cells at the lobe rims against the reference's 2.5 %.
notes: Deterministic: the same palette, parameters and seed give the same pixels.
A display render is capped at 2.4 megapixels; a slider in motion draws at half scale (down to a quarter on a heavy engine) and the release redraws in full.
This spec follows the controls: open it again, or leave it open, after changing them.
